crossRefs.note: “ ‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your daughter-in-law. She is your son’s wife. You shall not uncover her…
He turned to her by the way, and said, “Please come, let me come in to you,” for he didn’t know that she was his…
He said, “What pledge will I give you?” She said, “Your signet and your cord, and your staff that is in your hand.” He…
‘Cursed is he who lies with his mother-in-law.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
“ ‘You shall not lie with any animal to defile yourself with it. No woman may give herself to an animal, to lie down…

translations.web: “ ‘If a man lies with his daughter-in-law, both of them shall surely be put to death. They have committed a perversion. Their blood shall be upon themselves.
translations.bsb: If a man lies with his daughter-in-law, both must surely be put to death. They have acted perversely; their blood is upon them.
